about: 蓝白 · 第 7a 幕（F2h → F5）布局：唯一的数据源。Act07_Sea/Tools~/act07_layout.py 生成；搭建脚本 蓝白/Build/Act07a 读它建网格、填驱动；参考帧 Act07_Sea/Docs~/lookdev/scene_7a.py 也读它。圣经 v2.1 §6·7a，总导演裁决 D-09 / D-17 / D-21 / D-23。

frames.world: Unity, bus fixed at the origin, heading +z
frames.water: x right, y up from the sea surface (= -depth), z = bus heading
frames.eye_note: main seat eye = Gate cameras.U7 = render harness hero; LB_Journey.heroEye is (0.70, 1.77, 0.20)

window.note: the act-7 driver owns F2h - 1 .. exit + 1; this package fills 7a (to F5) and holds the 7a end state after F5 until 7b / 7c arrive

sink.law: v(t) = v0 + sum dv * smoothstep((t - t0) / dur); x(t) = exact integral from T0 (x(T0) = 0); smoothstep integral: x^3 - x^4 / 2 on [0, 1], then 0.5 + (x - 1)

forward.law: v(t) = v0 + sum dv * smoothstep((t - t0) / dur); x(t) = exact integral from T0 (x(T0) = 0); smoothstep integral: x^3 - x^4 / 2 on [0, 1], then 0.5 + (x - 1)

handover.note: F2h: the Clouds driver switches its sea off, this one switches the plane on (same y, ABOVE material M_06_Sea); at eye_under_t (the waterline covers the eye) the plane takes M_07a_SeaSurface, _Udon_Underwater 0 -> 1 (README_Sea接口 §5)

sea.object: Sea_Disc.fbx under R_Sea at water y 0
sea.window_gain_note: F3e1: 窗在 8 秒里从藍白缩暗成一枚暗币 (smoothstep), x the material _WindowGain (18)
sea.window_core_vr_law: VR: lerp(desktop, vr, smoothstep(0, 1, erosion(t) / 0.25)) with erosion(t) = the cabin fade 0 -> 0.25 linear F2h -> F5 (bible §4.8 table); the roof still there = the desktop numbers (D-23 #2)

water.law: by the bus ORIGIN depth: linear between keys (density, up, mid, down); _Udon_Fog = (density, 0, 0, 1), RenderSettings.fogDensity = density, _Udon_FogBase = 0, _Udon_WaterFog{Up,Mid,Down} = (rgb, 1)

caustics.note: x = strength (cabin floor depth = bus origin depth), z = t

sun.kind: the world main light (D-24: the one shadowed directional = RenderSettings.sun), driven, never switched off
sun.takeover: writeMainLight (LB_Journey.extSun): at eye_under_t (the waterline covers the turn) the driver turns it to el 70 / az +30, #B0D9F2, E; its shadows and culling (bible §1.6: Bus + Tentacles + Player + PlayerLocal) are left as they are; from the exit (922.36) the next act writes it
sun.cookie: CRT Lanbai/SeaCausticsCookie 256 ARGBHalf, size 1.5 m, put on the main light under water and taken off at the exit (fallback Sea/Textures/CausticsCookie_Static_256.png)

ambient_trilight.note: RenderSettings Trilight (bible §6·7a 补光); written by the owner of RenderSettings (给总控 第五批)

cabin.note: the timeline / cabin driver writes these (bible §4.8 table), listed so the reference frames use the same numbers

shafts.gain_law: g = depth fade until 453; 453 -> F4p: lerp(depth fade, 1, smoothstep) (they gather and brighten: F4p is their brightest); F4p -> 467.6: x (1 - smoothstep) to 0 (review r1 #1)

gather.note: F4p: the shafts converge on the skylight hole in 9 s; the gather point is the skylight (bus frame); the driver writes _GatherPoint in R_Sea object space each frame

last_shaft.note: F3e1: the last wide shaft sweeps across the seats (2 s in, 4 s sweep, 2 s out; seats <= luma 120): its foot moves from target_from to target_to (past the main seat at ~0.58), the beam light rides with it; the quad starts 2 m above its moving centre so the seats sit at uv.y ~0.45 (full strength), then all shafts are gone

beam.kind: Spot (bus frame, under R_Act07Bus), culling Bus + Player + PlayerLocal (no shadows): the light that lands on the seats and your hands

gather.curve: smoothstep 0 -> 1 from 453 to F4p 462.36, then smoothstep 1 -> 0 to 467.6

last.curve: the last shaft's alpha; position = the shaft centre, aim = its moving foot

beam.note: Inspector intensity = E (D-00: VRChat forces lightsUseLinearIntensity = true; the bible §1.5 trap 1 is void). Spot lights use Unity's legacy range falloff (trap 2): check against the grey card locally, the seats must stay <= luma 120 and <= 6 % of the frame. Expected (cloud estimate: Built-in diffuse = albedo x colour x E x atten + the cabin ambient of §cabin, legacy atten ~ 1 / (1 + 25 d^2 / range^2), graded): F4p the worn seat #6A3434 luma ~79, the base vinyl #5A2126 ~57, a mid-grey hand ~155; F3e1 (E 7.5) worn ~72, base ~52. Range 20 m so the falloff over the 4 m throw is 0.49, not 0.16 (range 9 needed E ~44)

snow_lit.note: sunlit flakes in the shallow water: the bible screen colour #697987 has the luma of the water behind it at F3 (both ~118) and the flakes vanish; x gain until 12 m, smoothstep to x 1 (the bible colour) by 30 m (给总控 第五批 #9)

material.note: low contrast: the faces sit just above the water fog of 105 m; only the silhouettes catch the hull bioluminescence #8AC6FF (bible: 只被船体生物荧光描出一道边), full strength out to rim_near_m, falling off over rim_reach_m beyond; wrap: the trails run along the whole hull

warm_point.halo_note: a soft halo of ~1.6 deg (<= 2 deg) around the point so it can be found at 640 px (终审 7a 二): a second, wider and dimmer point in the same mesh

grade.note: LB_Journey.ApplyGrades owns the PPv2 weights; the driver writes none of them. These are the data for its table (README_集成 §2 / §5): one dEV per frame, all events summed (bible §1.4)

events.shape: linear in EV down, linear back
events.note: bible §6·7a 入水 / score 22: the first gulp of dark under the water

events.at: the waterline over the window tops
events.shape: smoothstep S6 -> S7a (colour change, hidden behind the waterline)
linear weight (an exposure change: constant EV / s)

act7c.about: bible §6·7c + D-23; the sea kit look is M_07c_SeaMirror (Sea/SeaMaterials.json, K3 r17)

mirror.note: on from F8 (the fog hides it until ~F8a: 110 m below at 0.018 / m is 87 % fog); the 7a surface plane goes off at F8

act7c.wave_note: bible F8b: the waves decay to 30 % in 6 s; the mirror keeps them x _MirrorWave 0.25 (the lamps settle into points)
act7c.window_note: x the material _WindowGain (0.25) and _WindowSunGain: the window settles at 897.96
act7c.fog_note: mid = the bible (#04121E -> #2E2228 fill #3E2C2B -> #3A2629 fill #4B312C), up = mid x 0.75, down = a dark neutral (D-23 layering: the window indigo is not drowned in rose); the fog thins (bible F8c 雾在变薄): 0.018 -> 0.006 / m

caustics.note: F8c: the caustics come from BELOW for the first time (bible §4.8), strength 0 -> 1 with the window's dusk, F8c -> 921.4 (smoothstep; LanbaiCaustics.cginc header), gold #E2C08E h 80 (D-08: never rose)

rose_lights.culling: Bus + Player + PlayerLocal, no shadows, Not Important (folded into SH: free)
rose_lights.note: bible: 1-2 realtime point lights under the bus turn rose, following the arc in the window (the arc is forward, az 0): one low ahead of the windscreen, one low on the right. Grey-card check locally

trilight.note: bible §6·7c 光: Trilight ground #1A1422 -> #3A1C18 (7c end); sky / equator are not in the bible: a dark neutral and the fog's rose (sRGB values for RenderSettings)

waterline.note: Lanbai/SeaWaterline on COPIES of the glass meshes (wired locally, README §0): on in these windows, _WaterBelow +1 at the entry, -1 at the exit; it reads _Udon_SeaLevel (the clouds write it after the exit)
